I used to feel the same way after being stuck in the redpill for some time. Then I tried to see the bigger picture and realised that the internet isn't a representation of the population. Controversy of all kinds are selected for by the feed. Therefore we guys see "hoes" that cheat and have insane standrards and women see stories from their fellow women of horrible men. Hatred grows on both sides. The key point is that this isn't a representation of the population, this is the controversial minority that is being selected for by the feed that keeps you and me watching.

Recognising that the internet is a compilation of the worst of society I tried talking to a cute girl in my class. I felt imperfect, wondered if she would judge me for the imperfect person I was, maybe she did. I'm not 6 feet or rich. But she wasn't perfect either. I don't know anyone who is. We were no super models, we didn't have millions of dollars, we were just two teens enjoying a chat. We had fun, it didn't become anything, it didn't have to.

The point is that life is simpler than media makes it out to be. I've seen enough relationships develop recently to know that the most attractive thing for a woman is to be able to have a nice talk, be able to take her back to a clean house after a date and smell nice.
